title_lines: 人工智能热潮下需精选标的

subtitles.en: Our next guest, Christina Woon, is portfolio manager at eSpring investments. Christina, great to have you in the studio. So we're looking at, you know, quite a good start for this quarter so far.
subtitles.zh: 下一位嘉宾，Christina Woon，是eSpring的基金经理。Christina，欢迎来到演播室。我们看到本季度开局相当不错。

subtitles.en: All things considered Japan is outpacing career, but you also had that thematic of AI very clear in the second quarter.
subtitles.zh: 总体来看，日本表现优于韩国，但AI主题在第二季度也非常明确。

subtitles.en: Talk to us about the need to be maybe more selective this quarter and what is the trend underlying that you see.
subtitles.zh: 谈谈本季度是否需要更加精选标的，以及你看到的潜在趋势。

subtitles.en: Definitely, I think you're right. Being selective this quarter is going to be quite important because as we've been discussing or as we've seen, the past quarter has seen one of the strongest runs in a while within the tech space.
subtitles.zh: 确实，我认为你说得对。本季度精选标的非常重要，因为正如我们所见，过去一个季度科技板块出现了近期最强劲的上涨之一。

subtitles.en: And there's a lot to like about tech. It's got quite a deep supply chain and you can basically follow the bottlenecks within the supply chain to find alpha opportunities.
subtitles.zh: 科技板块有很多值得喜欢的地方。它有很深的供应链，你可以顺着供应链中的瓶颈找到超额收益机会。

subtitles.en: My concern is that these elevated levels and with the volatility we've seen in the market, you really have to be quite selective to be sure that you're picking stocks that haven't overshot on fundamentals.
subtitles.zh: 我担心的是，在目前的高位和市场波动下，你必须非常精选，确保你选择的标的没有在基本面上过度上涨。

subtitles.en: So that's the way I would frame the AI trade at this point. How do you feel about career now?
subtitles.zh: 这就是我目前对AI交易的理解。你现在怎么看韩国市场？

subtitles.en: Well, I think career still has the select memory names. The fundamentals there are still quite strong. You're still seeing memory prices holding up and actually increasing as well.
subtitles.zh: 我认为韩国市场仍有一些精选的存储类标的。基本面依然相当强劲，存储价格仍在上涨。

subtitles.en: I think that tightness and supply is still intact. The difficulty that we've seen or the added dynamic that's really come in has been from a flow perspective because the retail investor started to become a larger proportion of that and that can be quite volatile or add volatility to that trade as well.
subtitles.zh: 我认为供应紧张的局面依然存在。但我们看到的困难或新增的动态来自资金流方面，因为散户投资者开始占据更大比例，这可能会增加波动性。

subtitles.en: We've seen leverage ETFs, also be another dynamic that retail players have also participated in. So flows is something that's been a bit difficult to ignore. I would say is a dynamic we have to consider as well.
subtitles.zh: 我们还看到杠杆ETF，这也是散户参与的另一个动态。所以资金流是一个不容忽视的因素，我们必须考虑。

subtitles.en: And then starting today, you're seeing rebalancing domestically within PS2. So again, with career, while there are interesting stocks there that have structural runs, the flows part is something investors should keep in eye on.
subtitles.zh: 从今天开始，PS2内部也在进行国内再平衡。所以对于韩国市场，虽然有一些结构性上涨的标的，但资金流方面投资者需要密切关注。

subtitles.en: Christina, I was going to ask you about markets like Korea and Taiwan, for example, have done quite well. What you see in this market is it's increasingly become very retail driven. subtitles.en: Sure, that will still impact certain market sentiment as well, but it's really how you stay abreast of that or keep above the market in that sense.
subtitles.zh: 当然，这仍会影响市场情绪，但关键在于如何跟上市场步伐或保持领先。

subtitles.en: Yeah, when you look at some of the risks for the second half, I mean, it's interesting that at least the oil price has come down. We're talking more about steady dollar oil here right now, given that there has been progress when it comes to this around war.
subtitles.zh: 是的，展望下半年的风险，有趣的是至少油价已经回落。考虑到地缘局势取得进展，我们现在更多谈论的是稳定的美元油价。

subtitles.en: It seems to be slowly but surely opening up in some ways, but the macro risks are still there. I still see traders are pricing in rate height from the Fed.
subtitles.zh: 市场似乎在缓慢但稳步地开放，但宏观风险依然存在。我仍看到交易员在定价美联储加息。

clips.title: 伊斯特伯里**克里斯蒂娜·伍德：通胀压力未消，大宗商品价格仍处高位
title_lines: 大宗商品价格仍处高位

subtitles.en: I do think that's something that we need to bear in mind.
subtitles.zh: 我确实认为这是我们需要注意的。

subtitles.en: Even with oil prices coming off, they're still at fairly elevated levels, and in some markets you've seen subsidies come through to ensure that that hasn't really quite impacted the consumer yet.
subtitles.zh: 即使油价回落，仍处于相当高的水平，在一些市场，补贴措施出台以确保消费者尚未受到太大影响。

subtitles.en: So I think that's still a dynamic that we have to bear in mind.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这仍是我们需要关注的动态。

subtitles.en: It's not just all prices, but with certain commodity prices also, we've seen price inflation there.
subtitles.zh: 不仅仅是油价，某些大宗商品价格也出现了上涨。

subtitles.en: Even if things have corrected, these are still at fairly elevated levels.
subtitles.zh: 即使有所回调，这些价格仍处于相当高的水平。

subtitles.en: So while the risk has come off a little, there are different dynamics at play that mean that inflation is not something we can ignore.
subtitles.zh: 因此，尽管风险有所缓解，但不同的动态因素意味着通胀不容忽视。
en_highlights: inflation is not something we can ignore

subtitles.en: And the other part of that also from a macroeconomic perspective would be people will be looking to wear inflation levels kind of settle as well to guide where we see what sort of takes a view on from a rates perspective.
subtitles.zh: 从宏观角度看，另一方面，人们将关注通胀水平是否稳定，以指导利率前景的预期。

clips.title: 伊斯特伯里**克里斯蒂娜·伍德：韩国市场股息策略，企业改革带来机会

subtitles.en: So given the potential inflation backdrop, what else are you looking at potentially dividend yielding in this environment?
subtitles.zh: 那么在潜在通胀背景下，您还在关注哪些可能带来股息收益的资产？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I would say actually going back to Korea, some of the stocks there still have quite a strong dividend angle because what we've seen over the past few years in terms of corporate reform is one that's multi-year.
subtitles.zh: 是的，回到韩国市场，一些权益资产仍有很强的股息吸引力，因为过去几年我们看到的企业改革是多年期的。

subtitles.en: So we're still seeing some of these companies come up with dividend policies that are improving.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们仍看到一些公司推出改善的股息政策。

subtitles.en: So your payout ratios go up year-on-year or they're improving how they look at shelter return, whether it's based off of cash flows as well.
subtitles.zh: 因此，派息率逐年上升，或者他们改善了对股东回报的考量，包括基于现金流等。

subtitles.en: So that's a rhetoric that I would say actually support some of or any of the fraud that comes out of the Korean market too.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这种说法实际上也支持了韩国市场的一些或任何欺诈行为。

subtitles.en: So that's something that could be interesting.
subtitles.zh: 所以这可能会很有趣。
